title: Feeling the Ground: Contact From the Torque at the Joints, With a Blank After Lift-off and a Gap Between On and Off

artifact.note: telling that a foot is on the ground from an estimate of the force at the foot (from the joint torques, 34-02): a threshold to say on and a lower one to say off (so a force that hovers near one does not make the state flap), a count of readings in a row before a change is believed, and a blank after the foot is told to lift during which touchdown is not believed (the leg's own acceleration makes a spike); tested on a simulated step with noise, a lift-off spike and a grazing touch, to show how soon contact is found and what each of the three guards is for
